body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> iLuv debuted 'Tatz', its new line of high-end headphones and earphones at CES 2010, which offers the latest in precision acoustic engineering and contemporary styled graphics to best suit the taste of the quality demanding and style conscious consumer.

The Tatz(model: THP901) headphone is the perfect combination of design, comfort and sound engineering. Ladies can experience how absolute power sounds with these tight, yet comfortable fitting and seductively attractive pink designed headphones for $79.99.
